title: Creaking Angels
description: Creaking now teleport you distances as a part of their attack.
body:
![Minecraft update banner stylized to creaking angels datapack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92a8dce9358c6e211c1cc8a87943bb223a4db5d9_0.webp)
Creaking Angels is a small data pack built to buff creaking to be more intimidating. It takes major inspiration from, "Weeping Angels," a time manipulating alien from Doctor Who, which send you back in time to harvest your potential energy.

# Lite
The lite version is focused on gameplay. Creaking become a situationally dangerous monster. They still have paper cut attacks, but now they will teleport you a short distance away with slowness. With the right circumstances, you could be teleported right into a pack of monsters.

When you get attacked by a creaking:
- You are teleported 35 blocks away
- You are given 90s of slowness

# Extended
The extended version is focused on creating a parallel to the weeping angels. It has a very unbalanced and tedious recovery because of that. (Take this as a warning)

When you get attacked by a creaking:
- You are teleported 2000 blocks away
- Your inventory is transferred in a gravestone
- Your spawnpoint is set at your teleported destination

In order to return to where you left off:
- You must walk back to the gravestone to get your items
- You must sleep in a bed to change your spawnpoint

### Gravestones
![image of a creaking angels gravestone next to a graveyard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f3fdd965abd924ffed28c4b156fe10cbd8f318b.png)
